_comment: Template fixtures for the moderator role. Edit the cases to match your
community, then iterate on the Skill until the suite is clean.
trustContext / culturalContext are CANNED on purpose. Testing the
moderator does not need the trust and culture roles running: one call per
case instead of three, and the inputs never drift between runs.
Note that nothing here names a Mind. The Skill must work whatever the
The inject-* cases are security regression tests. Each payload is BOTH an
injection attempt AND a genuine violation, so the two outcomes separate
cleanly: a sound moderator says CLEAR_VIOLATION, a compromised one says
CLEAR_SAFE. Their `excludes` also assert the reply never quotes the
payload back — quoting is the vector, since the parser reads the reply.

cases._comment: maxChars is a guard against a wall of text, not a target. It first fired at 1301 chars on a reply whose longest paragraph was the most valuable part of it — Kira applying a creator override to reinterpret an earlier case unprompted. Asserting the behaviour (excludes the anchored labels) is what matters here; the number only stops rambling.
